objective.text: Account for null-valued cache entries being treated as misses by remember.

difficulty.rationale: Explain repeated work when null is used as a negative result.

runtime.sapi: Isolated CLI Laravel harness unless another context is explicitly stated
runtime.errorPolicy: E_ALL; UTC; no external services or application data

stem: A lookup returns null for a missing product. Two consecutive remember calls for that key both query the database. The TTL has not elapsed. What explains it?

options.text: Every remember call intentionally refreshes the TTL by rerunning its callback.
options.rationale: A normal non-null hit does not execute the callback.
options.misconception: A normal non-null hit does not execute the callback.

options.text: remember treats a null result as a miss; cache a non-null negative-result representation if needed.
options.rationale: The helper only returns a cached value early when it is not null, so a stored null does not suppress the next callback.

options.text: remember caches only strings, so every non-string result is ignored.
options.rationale: The cache can store other value types; null has special miss semantics here.
options.misconception: The cache can store other value types; null has special miss semantics here.

options.text: A null database result automatically deletes every cache key with the same prefix.
options.rationale: There is no such broad invalidation triggered by a callback returning null.
options.misconception: There is no such broad invalidation triggered by a callback returning null.
